activeQuestion.prompt: What should a rider with a nonfolding bike do?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 自行車不能折疊的騎士應該怎麼做？

options.text: Carry the bike onto the first shuttle.
options.zh: 直接把自行車帶上首班車。
options.whyZh: 只有折疊後的自行車才能直接帶上車。

options.text: Ask the first driver to put it on the trailer.
options.zh: 請首班車司機把車放上拖車。
options.whyZh: 首班車沒有拖車，無法載這輛自行車。

options.text: Wait for the next shuttle and load it onto the trailer.
options.zh: 等下一班車，再把自行車放上拖車。
options.whyZh: 不能折疊的自行車必須用拖車載運；下一班車有拖車，首班則沒有。

options.text: Leave it at the stop because the shuttle service cannot carry it.
options.zh: 把自行車留在車站，因為接駁服務完全不能載運。
options.whyZh: 下一班車掛有拖車，可載不能折疊的自行車。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 不能折疊的自行車必須用拖車載運；下一班車有拖車，首班則沒有。
activeQuestion.evidence: Folded bikes can go on any shuttle. Other bikes need a trailer. The first shuttle has none; the next does.

vocabulary.note: 由接駁車拖掛，可載運不能直接帶上車的物品。

options.whyZh: 圖書館站暫停停靠，臨時站也不在建築內。

options.text: Outside the swimming pool on Oak Street.
options.whyZh: 公告清楚指出臨時站位於 Oak Street 的泳池外，離圖書館約五分鐘步行距離。

options.text: Behind the Pine Avenue railway station.
options.whyZh: Pine Avenue 是施工道路，並未提到火車站。

originalQuestion.explanationZh: 公告清楚指出臨時站位於 Oak Street 的泳池外，離圖書館約五分鐘步行距離。
originalQuestion.evidence: the temporary stop outside the swimming pool on Oak Street

vocabulary.note: 在原站不能使用時替代服務的停靠位置。

group.title: A temporary river shuttle route
group.passage: Friday’s river shuttle skips Market Street for the fair. The sports centre is closer, but its path has steps. Riverside Gate has a level path. Folded bikes can go on any shuttle. Other bikes need a trailer. The first shuttle has none; the next does. Evening departures stay on schedule, but rides may take ten minutes longer. Train times haven’t changed.
group.passageZh: 星期五市集期間，河岸接駁車不停靠市場街。運動中心較近，但沿路有階梯；河岸入口的路是平的。折疊後的自行車可搭任何一班；其他自行車需要拖車。首班車沒掛拖車，下一班有。傍晚仍照表發車，但車程可能多十分鐘。火車時刻維持不變。
